data.title: 庄方宜 · 深夜书斋纯粹玉肌
data.description: 卸去一切衣物独立案前，羊脂白玉般的修长身段与挺拔胸脯暴露在幽微烛光下，墨黑渐青绿长发自然垂落，纯粹形态摄人心魄。
data.action: 独立于书案正前方，墨黑渐青绿长发垂落，微红着脸凝视镜头，身姿沐浴在温润烛火中
data.lighting: 案头烛台与幽微灯影交织的暖调光线，柔和勾勒身形轮廓金边
data.camera: full body standing, front view, eye level
data.promptProse: Zhuang Fangyi stands gracefully in front of the polished wooden desk in her quiet study, looking directly at the viewer with a gentle, bashful blush. Warm candlelight and soft lantern glow illuminate her delicate porcelain skin and long flowing hair, casting a tender rim light across her form while rich wooden bookshelves and scrolls softly frame the background.
data.nsfwProse: Completely unclad, her slender jade-smooth porcelain skin is softly bathed in warm candlelight as she faces forward.
data.animaCaption: She stands gracefully in front of the polished desk, looking at the viewer under the warm glow of candlelight.
